[[File:Nigerian Cheesy Sausage Masa.jpg|thumb|Masa from Bauchi State]]
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Nigeria|Cuisine of Nigeria]]
[[File:Food in Abuja 04.jpg|thumb|Plate of food with a masa at the bottom]]
'''Cheesy sausage masa''' is a variety of [[Cookbook:Nigerian Masa|Nigerian masa]]. It is very easy to make in no time and can be served with any fruit juice. The sausage is a great source of vitamins and minerals, and cheese is a source of protein and fat. 

== Ingredients ==

* [[Cookbook:Sausage|Sausage]]
* [[Cookbook:Cheese|Cheese]]
* Nigerian [[Cookbook:Masa (Hausa Rice Pancake)|rice masa]] batter

== Special equipment ==
* [[Cookbook:Nigerian Masa Pan|Masa pan]]
* [[Cookbook:Cooktop|Stovetop]] or [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]]

== Procedure ==

=== Batter ===
# Cut the sausage into small, evenly-sized pieces. Do the same for the cheese.
# Mix the sausage and cheese pieces with the masa batter.
# Cook the masa using either the oven or stove method below.

=== Cooking – Oven method ===
# Grease the masa pan.
# Fill each divot to the brim with the batter.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] in a preheated [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] until puffed, golden, and cooked through.
# Serve hot.

=== Cooking – Stove method ===
# Heat the masa pan on the stovetop.
# Add some oil to each divot, and let it get hot.
# Fill each divot to the brim with batter.
# Cook on one side until golden brown.
# Flip the masa over, and cook on the other side until golden brown and cooked through.
# Serve hot.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* For this recipe, you will need a [[Cookbook:Nigerian Masa Pan|masa pan]], which is a specialized pan with divots in it used to cook the masa.
